title: Portugal vs Spain
description: Hand-authored demo match in demo time (about 6 min 50 s at 1x). Early Ronaldo penalty, seven goals, four cards, four corners. Not a real fixture; not affiliated with any league or federation.

events.text: We're underway in Lisbon. Portugal in red, Spain in yellow.
Portugal on the front foot early. Leão is causing problems down the left.
PENALTY to Portugal! Laporte brings down Leão in the box. Ronaldo has the ball under his arm.
Ronaldo places it on the spot. Unai Simón is bouncing on his line.
Ronaldo steps up...
RONALDO SCORES! Sends Simón the wrong way. Portugal 1, Spain 0.
Yellow card for Rodri, a cynical pull on Bruno Fernandes.
Corner to Portugal. Bruno Fernandes will swing it in.
Dias rises highest and powers a header on target. Simón tips it over!
GOAL for Spain! Lamine Yamal cuts inside and curls one into the far corner. 1-1.
Palhinha goes into the book for a late challenge on Pedri.
Spain win a corner on the right. Big bodies coming forward.
Headed clear at the near post. Nothing doing for Spain.
GOAL! Portugal break at pace and Leão slides it under Simón. 2-1 Portugal.
Halftime. Portugal 2, Spain 1.
Second half is underway.
GOAL! Morata bundles it home from close range. Spain are level, 2-2.
Carvajal is booked for dissent.
Another Portugal corner. Ronaldo is lurking at the back post.
Ronaldo's header is on target but straight at Simón.
An hour gone and it is 2-2. Who gets the next one?
Portugal change: Bernardo Silva comes on.
GOAL! The substitute delivers. Bernardo Silva sweeps it in. Portugal 3, Spain 2.
Cancelo sees yellow for time wasting.
GOAL! Dani Olmo from the edge of the box. What a game: 3-3!
Ten minutes to go. Three apiece.
Spain corner. Everyone is up.
Overhit. It drifts out for a goal kick.
RONALDO AGAIN! A towering header in the 89th minute. Portugal 4, Spain 3!
The referee blows for full time.
Full time: Portugal 4, Spain 3.
